title: Relative Poincare duality for the de Rham complex of a proper smooth morphism with nonempty equidimensional fibres

difficulty_reason: The proposition is the relative form of Poincare duality: for a proper smooth morphism with nonempty equidimensional fibres of dimension $n$ there is a trace map on the top relative de Rham sheaf, unique up to a unit of the structure sheaf's global sections, making the derived pairing on $Rf_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$ a perfect pairing of perfect complexes on the base (statement lines 6317-6337). The proof transplants the absolute argument to the relative setting: it identifies the extreme relative cohomology sheaves through the relative Hodge-to-de Rham degeneration, builds the pairings from restrictions of the wedge product, and runs the same induction on the truncation parameter, but replaces the five-lemma step by a triangulated third-isomorphism argument and verifies compatibility of four pairs of maps through three commutative diagrams; uniqueness is again left to the reader. The relative bookkeeping with the derived category argument is the substance, so the claim is H3.
